ACHAEMENIDS.bonus: Town Centers can be upgraded to be more powerful starting in the Civic Age.
Stable technologies research 50% faster (-33% time taken).

ARMENIANS.bonus: Mule Carts cost -25%. Mule Carts replace Lumber Camps and Mining Camps.
Mule Cart technologies are 40% more effective.
Fortified Churches replace Monasteries, and the first one constructed receives a free Relic.
Long Swordsman and above, and Spearman line available one Age earlier.
The Galley line and Dromons* fire one additional projectile each, which deal 1 attack and advertised attack, respectively.

ATHENIANS.bonus: Athenians can be changed between Economic, Naval, and Military at the Town Center.
Lumberjacks generate food 1 for every wood 14.7.

AZTECS.bonus: Start the game with an Eagle Scout.
All military units are created 15% faster.
Monks gain 5 HP for every researched Monastery technology.

BENGALIS.bonus: Elephant units receive 25% less bonus damage and are more resistant to conversion.
All Town Centers spawn 2 Villagers when the next Age is reached.

BERBERS.bonus: Villagers move 5% faster in Dark Age, 10% faster starting in Feudal Age.
Cavalry units are 15%/20% cheaper in the Castle/Imperial Age.

BOHEMIANS.bonus: Chemistry and Hand Cannoneer available in Castle Age.

BRITONS.bonus: Town Centers cost wood -50% starting in the Castle Age.
Foot archers (except Skirmishers) have +1/+2 range in the Castle/Imperial Age.

BULGARIANS.bonus: Militia line units are upgraded for free.
Town Centers cost stone -50% (except starting Town Center).
Blacksmith and Siege Workshop technologies cost food -50%.

BURGUNDIANS.bonus: Economic upgrades (except Coinage and Banking) cost food -40% and are available one Age earlier.
Stable technologies are 50% cheaper. Cavalier upgrade available in the Castle Age.

BURMESE.bonus: Infantry units have +1/+2/+3 attack in the Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.

BYZANTINES.bonus: Buildings, Walls/Gates, and Farms have +10%/+20%/+30%/+40% hit points in the Dark/Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.
Camel Rider, Skirmisher, and Spearman lines are 25% cheaper.
Fire Ships and Dromons fire 25% faster.
Advancing to the Imperial Age is 33% cheaper.
Town Watch and Town Patrol are free.

CELTS.bonus: Infantry units move 5%/10%/15%/20% faster in the Dark/Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.
Non-Celt herdable animals can be converted regardless of units next to them.

CHINESE.bonus: Start game with +3 Villagers, but with food -200, wood -50.
Town Centers support 15 population (instead of 5) and have +7 Line of Sight.
Technologies are 5%/10%/15% cheaper in the Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age, respectively.
Fire Galley line and Fire Lancers move 5%/10% faster in the Castle/Imperial Age.

CUMANS.bonus: A second Town Center can be built in the Feudal Age.
Archery Ranges and Stables cost wood -75.
Siege Workshop and Battering Ram available in Feudal Age; Capped Ram upgrade available in Castle Age.
Mounted units move 5%/10%/15% faster in the Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.

DANES.bonus: Villagers and Fishing Ships drop off food +5%.
Units and buildings loot 25% of target's cost when destroying enemy buildings (except walls and gates).
Barracks and Siege Workshop technologies cost gold -66%.
Varangian Guards and Longships move 10% faster.

DRAVIDIANS.bonus: Receive wood 200 when advancing to the next Age.
Fishermen, Oyster gatherers, and Fishing Ships carry +15.
Skirmishers and Elephant Archers attack 25% faster.

ETHIOPIANS.bonus: Receive food +100, gold +100 whenever a new Age is reached.

FRANKS.bonus: Castles are 15%/25% cheaper in the Castle/Imperial Age.
Mounted units have +20% hit points (starting in the Feudal Age).

GEORGIANS.bonus: Start with a Mule Cart. Mule Carts replace Lumber Camps and Mining Camps.
Fortified Churches replace Monasteries, and provide +10% work rate to Villagers in a 21-tile square.
Units and buildings receive -20% damage (-40% instead of -25%) when fighting from higher elevation.
Mounted units regenerate 2/8/14 hit points per minute in the Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.

GOTHS.bonus: Infantry units are 15%/20%/25%/30% cheaper in the Dark/Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.
Infantry units have +1/+2/+3 attack bonus against Standard Buildings in the Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.
Hunters carry food +15; hunt lasts 20% longer.
+10 population cap in the Imperial Age.

GURJARAS.bonus: Start the game with a Camel Scout.
Starts with 2 Forage Bushes with food 175 each under the Town Center.
Can garrison Mills with herdable animals to produce food.
Mounted units deal +20%/+30%/+40% bonus damage in the Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.

HINDUSTANIS.bonus: Villagers are 8/13/18/23% cheaper in the Dark/Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.
Can build Caravanserais in the Imperial Age.

HUNS.bonus: Start the game with wood -100, but with the population cap at the maximum.
On Nomadic maps, the first Town Center spawns a Hunnic Horse.
Mounted archers are 10%/20% cheaper in the Castle/Imperial Age.
Trebuchets have +35% accuracy against units and small targets.

INCAS.bonus: Military units cost food -15%/-20%/-25%/-30% in Dark/Feudal/Castle/Imperial Ages
Villagers benefit from Blacksmith infantry technologies starting in the Castle Age.

ITALIANS.bonus: Advancing to the next Age is 15% cheaper.
Foot archers (except Skirmishers) and Condottieri +1/+1 armor.
Dock and University technologies are 25% cheaper.

JAPANESE.bonus: Fishing Ships have double hit points, +2 pierce armor, and work 5%/10%/15%/20% faster in the Dark/Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.
Mills, Lumber Camps and Mining Camps are 50% cheaper.
Infantry attack 33% faster starting in the Feudal Age.
Mounted archers +2 attack vs. Archers (except Skirmishers).

JURCHENS.bonus: Meat of hunted and livestock animals does not decay.
Mounted units and Fire Lancers attack 25% faster starting in the Feudal Age.
Siege Engineers available in the Castle Age.
Siege and fortification technologies cost wood -75%.
Siege and fortification technologies are researched 100% faster.
Military units receive -50% friendly fire damage.

KHITANS.bonus: The effects of Forging and Iron Casting are doubled.
Skirmishers, Genitours, and the Spearman and Scout Cavalry lines are trained and upgraded 15% faster.
Heavy Cavalry Archer upgrade available in the Castle Age and costs -50%

KHMER.bonus: No buildings are required to advance to the next age or to unlock other buildings.
Farmers don't carry food but rather add it directly to the stockpile without any drop-off, but work 5% slower.
Villagers (and Kings) can garrison in Houses.

KOREANS.bonus: Padded Archer Armor-line technologies, Watch Tower line upgrades, and the Bombard Tower technology are free (Bombard Tower requires Chemistry).
Archer and infantry units cost wood -50%.

LITHUANIANS.bonus: Each Town Center (including starting one) provides food +100.
Spearman line and Skirmishers move 10% faster.
Each garrisoned Relic gives +1 attack to Knights and Leitis (maximum +4).

MACEDONIANS.bonus: Take 10% less damage from enemies on higher elevation.
Recruitment Doctrines are available at the Barracks, Archery Range, and Stable.
Infantry armor upgrades also benefit cavalry.
Siege weapons have +1 pierce armor and +30% anti-building damage.

MAGYARS.bonus: Forging, Iron Casting, and Blast Furnace are free.
Villagers kill predators in one strike.

MALAY.bonus: Fish Traps are 33% cheaper and provide food 3×.
Battle Elephants are 25% cheaper in the Castle Age, 35% cheaper in the Imperial Age.

MALIANS.bonus: Buildings cost wood -15% (except Farms and starting Town Center).
Barracks units have +1/+2/+3 pierce armor in the Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.
Villagers drop off gold +10%: gold miners work 10% faster.

MAPUCHE.bonus: Settlements can train the Spearman and Skirmisher lines in 2.15×/1.61×/same time as regular production buildings in the Feudal/Castle/Imperial Ages, respectively.
Infantry, Slingers, and Skirmishers get +5/10/15 hit points in the Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.
Mounted units generate gold +3 per military unit killed.
Enemy Castles are revealed on the map.

MAYANS.bonus: Start the game with an Eagle Scout.
Start the game with +1 Villager, but with food -50.
Foot archers (except Skirmishers) are 10%/20%/30% cheaper in the Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.

MONGOLS.bonus: Scout Cavalry-line and Steppe Lancers +20/30% hit points in the Castle/Imperial Age.

MUISCA.bonus: Advancing to the next Age costs gold -50%.
Settlements cost -33% and heal allied human units within 3 tiles by 5/10/15/15 HP/min in the Dark/Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.
The Champi Scout line and Archery Range units have +1/2/3 melee armor in the Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.

PERSIANS.bonus: Start the game with food +50, wood +50.
Town Centers and Docks have double hit points and work 5%/10%/15%/20% faster in the Dark/Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.
Parthian Tactics available in the Castle Age.
Can build Caravanserais in the Imperial Age.

POLES.bonus: Villagers regenerate 10/15/20 hit points per minute in the Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.
Stone miners generate gold 33% in addition to stone.
Bloodlines and Scout Cavalry-line upgrades cost food -50%.

PORTUGUESE.bonus: Foragers generate wood in addition to food (wood 0.33 food per).

PURU.bonus: Villagers gathering from Stone Mines generate food 0.69 stone per.
Villagers and Fishing Ships gather from Oysters 15% faster.
Cavalry units heal 25 hit points per minute when no enemy units are within 10 tiles radius, starting in the Classical Age.
Lemboi cost -10/19/27% and gain +1/2/3 attack in the Civic/Classical/Imperial Ages respectively.

ROMANS.bonus: Villagers gather, build, and repair 5% faster.
Infantry receives double the effect from Blacksmith armor upgrades.

SARACENS.bonus: Transport Ships have double hit points and +20 carry capacity.

SAXONS.bonus: Mills, Lumber Camps, and Mining Camps provide food 35 when built.
Foot soldiers cost -5% per Town Center or Castle controlled (maximum -20%).
Towers and Castles fire +100% base arrows starting in Castle Age.
Longships and Catapult Galleons have +20% hit points.

SHU.bonus: Lumberjacks generate food 0.7 for every wood 10.
Archery unit technologies at the Archery Range and Blacksmith cost -25%.
All land siege units and Lou Chuans move +10/15% faster in Castle/Imperial Age

SICILIANS.bonus: Fortifications built 50%, Town Centers built 100% faster.
Land military units (except siege weapons) receive 40% less bonus damage.

SPANISH.bonus: Cannon Galleon projectiles can track moving targets and move faster.
Receive gold 20 for each technology researched.

SPARTANS.bonus: A Polemarch is spawned for free in both the Civic Age and Classical Age.
Villagers and Fishing Ships drop off 10% more food.
The Elite Hoplite upgrade is available in the Classical Age.

TATARS.bonus: Units deal +20% damage when attacking from higher elevations (+50% instead of +25%).
Parthian Tactics and Thumb Ring are free.
Two Sheep spawn near newly-constructed Town Centers starting in the Castle Age.

TEUTONS.bonus: Towers garrison twice as many units.
Murder Holes and Herbal Medicine are free.
Infantry and mounted units receive +1/+2 melee armor in the Castle/Imperial Age.

THRACIANS.bonus: (Elite/Imperial) Skirmishers regenerate 5 (10) hit points per minute.
Battle Drills is available in the Classical Age.
All buildings except Town Centers can be built on any elevation.
Forts and towers increase the work rate of nearby miners and lumberjacks in a square of aura range 8 by 15% and serve as resource drop sites for the respective resources.
Shepherds and hunters generate gold 3 per minute while gathering from animals (excluding Foxes).

TUPI.bonus: Start with +25 of each resource once the first Town Center is built.
Fallen units, except ships and siege weapons, return 15% of their cost.
Archery Range and Barracks technologies cost food -50%.

TURKS.bonus: Light Cavalry and Hussar upgrades are free.
Scout Cavalry line gain +1 pierce armor.

VARANGIANS.bonus: Shepherds, fishermen, and hunters drop off an additional gold 10% in addition to food; Fishing Ships generate an additional gold 5%.
Varangian Guards attack 25% faster and generate gold +50%.
Longships and Catapult Galleons attack 15% faster.

VIETNAMESE.bonus: Foot archers and Skirmishers +20% hit points.
Reveal enemy initial Town Centers location at the start of the game.
Economic technologies (except Coinage and Banking) cost no wood and are researched 100% faster.

VIKINGS.bonus: Warships cost -10%/-15%/-20% in the Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.
Infantry have +20% hit points starting from the Feudal Age.

WEI.bonus: Receive one free Villager for each economic technology researched
Hei Guang Cavalry and Xianbei Raider +20%/30% hit points in Castle/Imperial Age
Traction Trebuchets and Lou Chuans cost -25%

WU.bonus: Barracks, Archery Ranges, Stables, Siege Workshops, Castles, and Docks provide food +55 when constructed.
Infantry regenerate 10/15/30 hit points per minute in Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.
Jian Swordsmen and Hei Guang Cavalry have +2 attack in Imperial Age.
Careening and Dry Dock are free.
